name: CMS
what: A content management system built from two existing seams: markdown files become pages via Page.file(), and the dev socket writes files back.

demos.shows: Six screenshot cards of each section: thinking matrix, welcome content, edit interface, services mock, json tree, d1 database

gaps: No live editing demo in preview wall, only static screenshots
Database queries and actual backend interaction not shown
blurb: Markdown and dev socket seams become a full CMS without a backend.

name: Codrops
what: Twelve web animation effects from Codrops, rebuilt on this framework to show what the framework carries into effect code.

demos.shows: Twelve cards grouped by paging mechanism; cards show thumbnails of each effect

gaps: Index only shows card thumbnails, not the live effect animations
Must click each demo to see it in action
blurb: Twelve effects ported from Codrops, grouped by animation mechanism type.

name: Design
what: A design review of the entire site built from overnight screenshot crawl, with focused studies per design dimension.

demos.shows: Fourteen cards with screenshot previews of each design study topic

gaps: Index shows only card thumbnails with titles
Must click to see the actual design analysis
blurb: Screenshot-based design analysis of the site with ten focused study pages.

stage.should_cap: width: full spreads thumbnails wide at 3440, could constrain with measure

name: Feeds
what: Three small data-driven pages: a lazy YouTube embed picker, one dataset rendered three ways with a shared filter, and one live weather API.

demos.shows: Three cards with screenshot previews of video, data, and live sections

gaps: Actual filtering, data views, and API interaction require clicking into children
blurb: YouTube picker, multi-view dataset, and live API in one column.

name: Gallery
what: Browsable collections of framework pages imported from elsewhere and shown with their own preview, never moved or copied.

demos.shows: Three cards showing Lists, Answers, and Cards collections with thumbnail previews

gaps: Index does not explain what borrowing means
Must read Answers child to understand the architecture
Collections themselves are not shown, only three category cards
blurb: Framework pages borrowed and previewed, explained in Answers child.

name: The world
what: A text adventure game whose only mechanic is navigation: realms and rooms are pages, exits are links to siblings, state persists in browser storage.
features: Multiple endings based on player discovery

demos.shows: Playable game with three realms, nine rooms, trading, items, and two endings; interactive on first load

gaps: All core mechanics are playable from the index page itself
blurb: Text adventure using navigation, persistence, and a trading system.
